mentions.name: Lambda Calculus Turtle Graphics
mentions.description: This project implements turtle graphics using lambda functions, built as a hands-on experiment to learn lambda calculus. The author notes it may not have interesting applications beyond that learning goal.
mentions.source_excerpt: Turtle graphics with lambda functions. I don't know if it has any interesting applications, but I wanted to learn lambda calculus
